info.name: Fundsroom ERP CRM API
info.description:
# Fundsroom ERP CRM API

## Overview
REST API collection for the **Fundsroom ERP-CRM Operations Portal**, an enterprise wholesale and distribution management platform. This collection covers Authentication, Customer CRM, Product Catalog, AWS S3 Image Uploads, Stock & Inventory Control, Sales Challans, Payment Tracking, PDF Generation, and Role-Based Authorization.

## Base URL
`{{baseUrl}}` (Default Production: `https://fundsroom-erp-crm-operations-portal-1.onrender.com`)

## Authentication
Protected requests require a standard **JWT Bearer Token** in the header:
`Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`
Executing any Login request automatically captures and sets `{{token}}` in your Postman environment.

## System Roles & Permissions
- **ADMIN**: Access to all endpoints.
- **SALES**: Manage customers, follow-ups, and sales challans (Draft & Confirm).
- **WAREHOUSE**: Manage product catalog, S3 image uploads, and Stock IN / Stock OUT movements.
- **ACCOUNTS**: View orders, verify payments, mark PAID, and export PDF Tax Invoices.

## Automated Environment Variables
- `{{baseUrl}}`: API Root Base URL
- `{{token}}`: JWT Token (Auto-populated via Login)
- `{{customerId}}`: Customer UUID (Auto-populated via Create Customer)
- `{{productId}}`: Product UUID (Auto-populated via Create Product)
- `{{challanId}}`: Challan UUID (Auto-populated via Create Draft Challan)

### Login (ADMIN)
Authenticates Admin user credentials and returns user details alongside a JWT token. Automatically saves JWT `token` into environment.

Authenticates Sales user credentials for customer management and challan processing.

Authenticates Warehouse staff credentials for inventory stock adjustments and image uploads.

### Login (ACCOUNTS)
Authenticates Accounts user credentials for payment status updates and invoice downloads.

### Get Current User
Returns the current authenticated user's ID, name, email, and role based on the Bearer JWT token.

request.description:
### Update Customer
Updates existing customer details by ID.
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, SALES

### Add Customer Follow-up
Logs a sales follow-up note and schedules the next follow-up date for the customer.
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, SALES

### Get Customer Follow-ups
Fetches full historical list of follow-up notes for the specified customer.
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, SALES, ACCOUNTS

### Get Customer Challans & Stats
Returns customer's complete challan history alongside aggregated statistics (total, confirmed, draft, cancelled, paid, unpaid).
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, SALES, ACCOUNTS

### Delete Customer
Deletes a customer and cascades deletion of related orders inside a database transaction.
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, SALES

### Get Products
Retrieves product catalog. Supports query filters:
- `page`: Page number
- `limit`: Page size
- `search`: Filter by productName or SKU
- `category`: Filter by category name
- `lowStock`: Set `true` to filter items where `currentStock <= minimumStock`

request.description:
### Create Product
Adds a new product entry to the catalog. Auto-saves created `productId` into environment.
Required fields: `productName`, `sku`, `category`, `unitPrice`, `currentStock`, `minimumStock`.
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, WAREHOUSE

### Get Product By ID
Fetches product details by ID. Replaces AWS S3 object key with presigned view URL automatically if available.
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, WAREHOUSE, SALES, ACCOUNTS

### Update Product
Updates product pricing, threshold, title, or location.
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, WAREHOUSE

### Delete Product
Deletes a product entry from the catalog.
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, WAREHOUSE

item.name: 04 Product Images & AWS S3

request.description:
### Upload Product Image (AWS S3)
Uploads an image file (`multipart/form-data` with field `image`, max 5MB) to AWS S3. Updates `imageUrl` on the Product record and returns an S3 presigned view URL.
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, WAREHOUSE

### Get Presigned Image URL
Generates a temporary presigned AWS S3 view URL (600s expiration) for an S3 object key.
Allowed Roles: Authenticated Users

item.description: AWS S3 file upload and presigned URL retrieval endpoints.

item.name: 05 Stock & Inventory

request.description:
### Stock IN
Performs a manual Stock IN operation: increases product `currentStock` and creates a `StockMovement` log of type `IN` inside an atomic transaction.
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, WAREHOUSE

### Stock OUT
Performs a manual Stock OUT operation: validates sufficient inventory, decreases `currentStock`, and logs a `StockMovement` of type `OUT` inside an atomic transaction.
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, WAREHOUSE

### Get Stock Movements
Retrieves paginated audit log of all stock movements. Filterable by `productId` and `type` (`IN` | `OUT`).
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, WAREHOUSE, ACCOUNTS

item.description: Inventory stock adjustments and movement audit logs.

item.name: 06 Sales Challans

request.description:
### Get Challans
Retrieves paginated list of sales challans. Filters:
- `status`: DRAFT | CONFIRMED | CANCELLED
- `paymentStatus`: UNPAID | PAID
- `customerId`: Filter by customer UUID

Allowed Roles: ADMIN, SALES, ACCOUNTS

request.description:
### Create Draft Challan
Generates a new Sales Challan in `DRAFT` state with auto-generated number `CHL-YYYYMMDD-XXXX`. Snapshots item prices into `ChallanItem` rows. Does NOT deduct stock in draft status. Auto-saves `challanId` into environment.
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, SALES

### Update Draft Challan

Allowed Roles: ADMIN, SALES

exec: pm.test('Challan status updated to CONFIRMED', function () {

request.description:
### Confirm Challan
**Primary Business Operation**: Confirms a draft challan. Executed inside an atomic database transaction (`prisma.$transaction`):
1. Verifies challan status is `DRAFT`.
2. Validates inventory levels for all items.
3. Prevents stock from becoming negative.
4. Deducts quantity from `currentStock` of each product.
5. Creates `OUT` stock movement audit logs.
6. Updates challan status to `CONFIRMED`.
7. Commits transaction atomically.

Allowed Roles: ADMIN, SALES

Cancels a draft challan and updates status to `CANCELLED`.
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, SALES

request.description:
### Generate Sales Challan PDF
Generates and streams a PDF Sales Challan document using PDFKit. Returns binary `application/pdf` stream.
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, SALES, ACCOUNTS

### Generate Tax Invoice PDF
Generates an official Tax Invoice for `CONFIRMED` orders including company GSTIN (`27AABCU9603R1ZM`), customer details, itemized totals, CGST (9%) + SGST (9%), and terms. Returns binary `application/pdf` stream.
Allowed Roles: ADMIN, SALES, ACCOUNTS
